decisions.reason: The source concerns no-referral ticket and commission visibility on the leaderboard and in NFT attributes, not home-page mint, prize-pool, or referral aggregate statistics.
The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY requiring randomly assigned no-code rewards to appear in NFT attributes; no additional update or removal is needed.
The source reports missing presentation of no-referral rewards but does not change the established $15 primary-sale allocation.

The candidate already requires a successful no-code mint to allocate the $5 commission randomly; the source reports a failure to reflect that reward but does not change its allocation rule or resolve the first-mint ambiguity.
The source specifically identifies leaderboard and NFT-attribute visibility, not the separate frontend reward summary shown in the NFT detail view.
The completed mint and missing no-code rewards do not change which successfully minted NFTs must appear on the dashboard.
The source names the leaderboard and NFT attributes, not the user's dashboard reward summary, so propagation to dashboard reward-state fields is not entailed.
Missing ticket and commission attributes do not alter the requirements for cover, image, or wallet asset presentation.
The source does not concern metadata or image endpoint resolution.
The source reports a no-referral mint through an unspecified payment path and does not change fiat-user wallet provisioning, authentication, email, or reward-access behavior.
This runtime report does not request any change to About-page explanatory copy.
No NFT transfer occurred or was discussed, so the book, referral-code, badge, and ticket transfer semantics remain unchanged.
